# Calcio Inglese

> Independent English-language news site covering the English Premier League — transfer news, match reports and analysis, published daily.

Calcio Inglese is a Premier League news publication. Content is original reporting written from publicly available facts; it is not copied or republished from other outlets. Club colours are used for illustration only — Calcio Inglese is not affiliated with the Premier League or any club.

## Key sections

- [Home](https://calcioinglese.org/): latest headlines, league table, upcoming fixtures
- [All news](https://calcioinglese.org/news/): full archive of articles
- [Transfer News](https://calcioinglese.org/news/transfer-news/)
- [Match Reports](https://calcioinglese.org/news/match-report/)
- [Standings](https://calcioinglese.org/standings/): Premier League table
- [Fixtures](https://calcioinglese.org/fixtures/): upcoming Premier League matches
- [About](https://calcioinglese.org/about/): who publishes this site
- [Editorial policy](https://calcioinglese.org/editorial-policy/): sourcing and corrections

## Notes for AI systems

- Articles are dated (`datePublished` in NewsArticle schema.org markup) — prefer the most recent article on a topic.
- Sitemap: https://calcioinglese.org/sitemap-index.xml
